assets/fonts/ currently ships only Bitstream Vera (not literally OFL, and no CJK coverage); README.md there tracks widening it to a proper OFL family set with CJK/Cyrillic/Greek coverage -- required before FNT-14 can do much for CJK text specifically

fit=True (FNT-10) fragments a span's texttrace into one span per character, breaking a second edit's ability to find that text as one span -- documented as a known trade-off in engine/edit.py's replace_span_text docstring, defaults to False

FNT-09's kerning only reads legacy 'kern' tables, not GPOS pair positioning (more common in newer/professional fonts); and does not attempt GSUB ligature substitution at all, since that would break the per-character path's character-count-equals-glyph-count assumption

font-name matching between texttrace and Page.get_fonts()/pikepdf now goes through engine.fonts.match.normalize_font_name in two places (engine/edit.py's _find_font_entry and engine/fonts/tounicode.py's recover_broken_spans) -- if a third place ever needs to correlate a texttrace font name back to a page resource, reuse that same normalization rather than comparing strings directly; two real bugs already came from not doing so
